02 / READ THE MECHANISM

MINT. BURN. REPEAT.
What does $OTCBURN do?

The proposed system uses an allocated share of memecoin creator fees to buy $OTC, mint an OTC Desk NFT, then destroy that NFT on-chain. The mint burns $OTC; the subsequent NFT burn destroys the newly created desk. The fee allocation will be published before launch.

What counts as a burned desk?

A desk will be counted only after its NFT burn transaction is confirmed and the asset's destroyed state is verified. Sending an NFT to another wallet is not counted as destruction. This interface currently has no live blockchain connection.

Where can I verify the transactions?

Once connected, each cycle will show separate purchase, mint, and NFT burn transaction links. Missing or failed burns will stay pending and will not increase the destroyed count.

Is the burn system live?

This is a pre-launch website prototype. OTC burn compatibility and vault behavior still require verification. The artwork illustrates the intended mechanism; it is not evidence of completed burns. No claim is made about changes to other desks' rewards. The token address, treasury, fee allocation, and execution service are not connected.

Inside the burn cycle

01
Collect creator fees

The project's allocated fees accumulate in its treasury.

02
Buy $OTC

Reserve SOL for costs and purchase the required mint amount.

03
Mint the desk

The mint consumes $OTC and creates an OTC Desk NFT.

04
Destroy the NFT

Submit an NFT burn, verify its final state, and record the proof.
